noise.ffmpeg_route: Generate seeded native noise on a neutral grayscale carrier at the declared grain resolution. Subtract the carrier center to obtain a signed residual; replicate one residual into RGB for monochrome or use independently seeded residual planes for color. Scale the residual with the declared grain reconstruction and add it to straight source RGB in the declared working transfer. Preserve original alpha and re-premultiply. A direct noise fast path is admitted only when its negotiated format, channel correlation and clipping match this request; headroom-preserving mode combines residuals in floating point through a qualified blend expression or the bounded packed-source/guide geq adapter, without quantizing the base picture to the noise carrier. Apply clip, preserve-headroom or normalized modulo wrapping only after signed residual addition, according to the selected overflow variant.
noise.target_schema_boundary: Amount; seed; uniform/Gaussian sample distribution; static/temporal frame policy; grain size and reconstruction; monochrome/independent RGB; working transfer; overflow=clip-to-domain, preserve-headroom or wrap-unit. Alpha is unchanged. No octave/persistence control is exposed as sample grain.
noise.parameter_or_algorithm_difference: Native noise sequence and Numera grain reconstruction replace donor hash identity. Perlin is not a substitute for independent sample grain. Signed residual addition is required for the unclipped mode; integer filter-output clamping cannot implement that mode. Source-frame/seed scheduling must remain consistent across the admitted playback and export paths. FilmCraft unclipped output preserves headroom; EffectCraft Noise unclipped output wraps modulo one. Those are separate named overflow variants, not a shared ambiguous clip=false flag.
noise.resource_strategy: One low-resolution residual for monochrome or at most three for color; reuse it across channel composition; cache static patterns. Bound generated dimensions, resampling, queue depth and any packed-canvas allocation. Zero amount bypasses the effect.
noise.qualification_focus: Concrete schema/build admission; actual output correctness, alpha/color/time semantics and bounded resources; native GUI/browser GUI/CLI/stdio MCP/HTTP MCP parity. On a neutral ramp, monochrome has equal RGB residuals in the selected transfer while color has independent channels; increasing grain size changes spatial correlation. Zero amount is identity, original alpha is unchanged, repeated seeded/frame-policy renders agree, and preserve-headroom retains values outside the clip domain before final output conversion. A wrap-unit variant must wrap both negative and over-white values into the declared unit interval rather than clamp them or preserve headroom.

lens_flare.ffmpeg_route: Generate an authored light field independently of source highlights: a compact analytic core/halo plus at most eight disc/ring ghosts positioned on the line from the authored flare center through frame center, and an optional bounded axis streak. Use color/nullsrc plus geq in the admitted working precision, or drawvg only for a separate coverage layer; native gblur may soften that layer. Color the field and composite with the source using explicit add/screen and the shared emitted-light alpha contract. No source threshold is required to create the flare.

vignette.ffmpeg_route: For the shaped mode, evaluate a bounded elliptical/superelliptical border weight M from center, aspect/roundness, midpoint and feather in geq. Let w=abs(amount)*M; in straight RGB compute (1-w)*source+w*target, choosing the authored dark color for negative amount and declared white for positive amount, then preserve alpha and re-premultiply. A named natural-lens preset may use native vignette forward/backward with center/angle/aspect; that preset has its own documented falloff and is not silently substituted for the shaped blend. Highlight protection, when selected, attenuates the border weight using source luminance.
vignette.target_schema_boundary: Signed amount and mix; mode=shaped-border or natural-lens; center; shaped midpoint/roundness/feather/dark color and white reference; lens angle/aspect for the native preset; working transfer; optional highlight protection. Define feather=0 as a hard edge without division by zero; alpha is unchanged.
vignette.parameter_or_algorithm_difference: Darkening requires weighted replacement/multiplication, not addition or screen. The native forward/backward lens gain and shaped color/white interpolation are explicit variants of the same canonical descriptor; they are not numerical aliases. No glow, ray gather, seed or highlight extraction is part of the ordinary vignette.
vignette.resource_strategy: One per-pixel field/formula; static weights may be cached. No blur pyramid or separate light-source graph. Zero amount bypasses processing; bound shape exponent and feather inputs.
vignette.qualification_focus: Concrete schema/build admission; actual output correctness, alpha/color/time semantics and bounded resources; native GUI/browser GUI/CLI/stdio MCP/HTTP MCP parity. A uniform gray frame darkens at corners for negative shaped amount and brightens for positive amount while its center remains unchanged; center/roundness/feather each change the intended geometry. Zero amount and zero lens angle are identity in their respective modes. Preserve alpha/HDR base precision and verify highlight protection only reduces the selected change.

turbulent_displace.ffmpeg_route: Generate one or two synchronized seeded Perlin guide fields with bounded octaves. For turbulent X/Y modes use independent fields; directional modes zero one component; bulge/twist modes use fixed-neighbor derivatives of one field, rotating the derivative vector for twist. Scale by signed pixel amount and the explicit edge-pin envelope, then actually sample source RGBA at the resulting coordinates. Use native displace only for its qualified format/map domain, explicitly encoding the neutral, signed scale and edge mode (the documented 8-bit neutral example is 128). For fractional, wider-range or floating-point requests outside that domain, pack source and an RGB guide strip into a checked same-format FFmpeg vstack canvas, use geq channel lookups to read guide values and bilinearly sample only the original source rectangle, then crop back to the original dimensions. Apply the same coordinates to source alpha. Clamp/wrap/mirror/blank decisions occur against source bounds, never the guide strip.
turbulent_displace.target_schema_boundary: Signed amount in working pixels; scale/offset; bounded octave/persistence; seed and declared evolution/time policy; independent-XY, horizontal, vertical, gradient-bulge or rotated-gradient-twist mode; pin envelope; edge behavior; sampling/quality domain. Declare actual native-map and packed-canvas dimension/format limits; no silent clipping of requested displacement.
turbulent_displace.parameter_or_algorithm_difference: The native Perlin pattern replaces donor fractal/RNG identity, but the result remains a coordinate warp. A color/noise overlay is not this effect. The fallback is a finite FFmpeg graph, not a Rust pixel sampler. Native map quantization and any reduced guide resolution are declared quality properties; the base image must not silently lose float/HDR precision.
turbulent_displace.resource_strategy: At most two guide fields, a fixed derivative footprint and one bounded sampling stage. Check canvas height/width arithmetic, negotiated pixel format, alpha layout, framesync termination and total queued bytes before constructing the packed fallback; its source-plus-guide canvas is explicitly accounted for. Bound guide resolution/octaves; reuse static fields and bypass zero amount. Qualify cost before advertising a fast path.

echo_glow.ffmpeg_route: Extract a source-derived soft-knee highlight image once in the declared working light domain. Split that image into 1-12 native gblur levels with radii r_i=r0*spread^i; weight each level by d^i, normalize by the finite nonzero sum, tint the accumulated light and add/screen it with the source using the shared alpha contract. A separate authored gradient or blob field cannot replace the source-highlight image.
echo_glow.target_schema_boundary: Level count 1-12; base radius; spread >=1; decay coefficient d in [0,1]; threshold/soft knee; intensity; tint; add/screen mix; declared alpha/working-color policy. Validate the largest derived radius before graph construction.
echo_glow.parameter_or_algorithm_difference: Numera uses explicit radii and normalized geometric weights; donor constants and parameter-unit mapping are not identity requirements. Increasing the level count adds progressively wider source-derived glows, not independent procedural light sources.
echo_glow.resource_strategy: Threshold once and share its output; use a bounded blur pyramid or bounded split-and-mix graph. Cap active levels, largest radius, quality-map size and framesync queues. Do not allocate one independent source decode per level.
echo_glow.qualification_focus: Concrete schema/build admission; actual output correctness, alpha/color/time semantics and bounded resources; native GUI/browser GUI/CLI/stdio MCP/HTTP MCP parity. A bright impulse creates concentric progressively wider halos, while a black or below-threshold frame produces no glow. Generate at most 48 unrolled samples per color/coverage channel, use bilinear sampling with an explicit boundary rule, then scale the rays back, tint and add/screen with the source or return the rays-only branch. This samples actual highlight pixels along each point-to-center segment; an authored radial gradient is not a substitute.

cell_pattern.ffmpeg_route: Generate a true bounded nearest-site cellular field in FFmpeg geq. For each output coordinate, enumerate a fixed 5x5 neighborhood of lattice cells, derive one deterministic seeded site per cell with jitter/evolution constrained to that cell, and maintain the smallest and second-smallest Euclidean distances F1/F2 plus the nearest site ID using finite expression terms. Compile the selected distance, F2-F1 boundary, site-color or named combined pattern from those values, then apply contrast/invert/overflow and output scaling. For tiled variants wrap the site identity on the tile lattice while retaining the correct neighboring site positions. Rust constructs constants and the finite expression; FFmpeg evaluates the pixels. Perlin and cellauto do not implement this route.

ec.stylize.ccvignette.target_semantics_and_differences: Canonical natural-lens forward/backward falloff and an explicitly shaped feathered-border variant share one vignette descriptor. Donor amount units/math are replaced; alpha is preserved and optional highlight protection reduces the selected border weight.
ec.stylize.ccvignette.ffmpeg_route_design: For the shaped mode, evaluate a bounded elliptical/superelliptical border weight M from center, aspect/roundness, midpoint and feather in geq. Let w=abs(amount)*M; in straight RGB compute (1-w)*source+w*target, choosing the authored dark color for negative amount and declared white for positive amount, then preserve alpha and re-premultiply. A named natural-lens preset may use native vignette forward/backward with center/angle/aspect; that preset has its own documented falloff and is not silently substituted for the shaped blend. Highlight protection, when selected, attenuates the border weight using source luminance.
ec.stylize.ccvignette.inputs_and_component_qualification: Signed amount and mix; mode=shaped-border or natural-lens; center; shaped midpoint/roundness/feather/dark color and white reference; lens angle/aspect for the native preset; working transfer; optional highlight protection. Define feather=0 as a hard edge without division by zero; alpha is unchanged. CI: Concrete schema/build admission; actual output correctness, alpha/color/time semantics and bounded resources; native GUI/browser GUI/CLI/stdio MCP/HTTP MCP parity. A uniform gray frame darkens at corners for negative shaped amount and brightens for positive amount while its center remains unchanged; center/roundness/feather each change the intended geometry. Zero amount and zero lens angle are identity in their respective modes. Preserve alpha/HDR base precision and verify highlight protection only reduces the selected change.
ec.stylize.ccvignette.resource_policy: One per-pixel field/formula; static weights may be cached. No blur pyramid or separate light-source graph. Zero amount bypasses processing; bound shape exponent and feather inputs.
ec.stylize.ccvignette.review_basis: Bounded v5 alias reconciliation: pinned stylize2.rs lines 498-528 uses a multiplicative falloff with optional highlight protection, while FilmCraft uses a shaped signed blend. Preserve named variants instead of silently equating natural gain and color interpolation. Design only.

ec.noise.noise.ffmpeg_route_design: Generate seeded native noise on a neutral grayscale carrier at the declared grain resolution. Subtract the carrier center to obtain a signed residual; replicate one residual into RGB for monochrome or use independently seeded residual planes for color. Scale the residual with the declared grain reconstruction and add it to straight source RGB in the declared working transfer. Preserve original alpha and re-premultiply. A direct noise fast path is admitted only when its negotiated format, channel correlation and clipping match this request; headroom-preserving mode combines residuals in floating point through a qualified blend expression or the bounded packed-source/guide geq adapter, without quantizing the base picture to the noise carrier. Apply clip, preserve-headroom or normalized modulo wrapping only after signed residual addition, according to the selected overflow variant.
ec.noise.noise.inputs_and_component_qualification: Sample-noise variant uses unit grain size and the shared mono/color/working-transfer contract. Clip, headroom and normalized modulo wrapping are explicit distinct modes. A direct native noise path is admitted only when its format, channel correlation and clipping match the selected mode. CI: Concrete schema/build admission; actual output correctness, alpha/color/time semantics and bounded resources; native GUI/browser GUI/CLI/stdio MCP/HTTP MCP parity. On a neutral ramp, monochrome has equal RGB residuals in the selected transfer while color has independent channels; increasing grain size changes spatial correlation. Zero amount is identity, original alpha is unchanged, repeated seeded/frame-policy renders agree, and preserve-headroom retains values outside the clip domain before final output conversion. A wrap-unit variant must wrap both negative and over-white values into the declared unit interval rather than clamp them or preserve headroom.
ec.noise.noise.resource_policy: Use the direct native fast path for compatible clipped sample noise. Otherwise use at most three small residual planes and bounded high-precision composition; do not add Perlin/octave synthesis to this variant.
ec.noise.noise.review_basis: Bounded v5 alias review of pinned misc.rs lines 448-480: correlated monochrome noise and the clip=false modulo-wrap branch were inspected. A bare native noise invocation does not establish those semantics; wrap must not be mislabeled preserve-headroom. Share the canonical residual/composition route. Design only.
ec.noise.noise.target_semantics_and_differences: Add monochrome or independent colored sample noise with explicit clip, preserve-headroom and wrap-unit variants in the canonical descriptor. EffectCraft clip=false corresponds to normalized modulo wrapping; FilmCraft clip=false preserves headroom. Keep those variants distinct. Native stochastic sequence replaces donor hash identity.

qualification_status: All replacements are source-informed design corrections. No application build, FFmpeg graph, media fixture or GPU test was run.
